notes: Ibn Abbas heard the report from Abu Sufyan (text: «أخبرني أبو سفيان»), so the chain runs past Ibn Abbas to Abu Sufyan
the saying is Heraclius's words («أن هرقل، قال له»), relayed by Abu Sufyan: Heraclius is the last link by rule 6
the Muslim and Bukhari correspondences name only the Companion, so this chain is longer than the stored one
